answer: One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. For every honest agent the nadir is aged, the anchor is settled, and the marble is long; for every farm the three are fresh, borrowed, and blank. Let every applicant face the same trial with Cloisonne setter crimson enamel medallion mark enamelled onto the enamel gallery, and let the answer read as each crimson enamel medallion is an enamel weight weighed beside the makers mark. The fine for one forgery is 2 times the stake, so a 237 POA proof becomes a 2x loss when the panel finds it.
